clues: This city is the main town of its district in Assam, in India. It is the next largest city of its state as well.
The wet monsoon moves in as early as April here. For seven months, days stay hot and wet, with hard storms most afternoons.
This city was founded in 1832 by Captain Thomas Fisher. He moved the main office of his district to a spot in the city that year.
This city holds the world's first polo club, set up long ago. The first true polo match of the sport was played here as well.
In 1985, a flight from Kolkata to this city made world history. Each member of its crew was a woman, a first for the whole world.
